pages.title: Shape a Steady Crystal
pages.text: Place an amethyst shard at the center, ringed by eight gold nuggets, to shape two White Aura Crystals. Steady White Aura flows along level paths or downward. Begin $(l:aura:first_aura_circuit)your first circuit$(/l).

pages.title: White Aura Crystal
pages.text: Use a White Aura Crystal directly on a Node or Pump for 1,000 matching Aura. Dropped crystals also work; place them on the side away from nearby Nodes.
